Diagram rendering for docs payloads — markdown

UX surfaceBoot surfaces: what the user sees first on each bundle.

Members

FONT_SIZE_FALLBACK

Default font size when the computed style is unparsable.

EDGE_RE

Cheap source scanners feeding the diagram-cost model — counts of each structural feature, not a parse (the wasm engine still does that).

countMatches

Counts regex matches without allocating a match array.

predictDiagramCost

Scores a diagram's predicted render+layout cost through the ONNX diagram-cost model (WebNN → WebGPU → wasm EP). When the predicted cost clears DIAGRAM_DEFER_MS the caller yields one task turn before rendering so a large graph can't long-task the docs view between blocks. A null score (no runtime/model) means render immediately — the same behavior as before the model existed.

  • @param source Raw mermaid source for the block.
  • @returns Predicted cost in ms, or null when ML is unavailable.

yieldTask

Yields one macrotask turn — cheap cooperative scheduling point.

themeJson

Reads the live theme custom properties + computed type into the engine's theme JSON — the diagram inherits the project's ink/surface/accent tokens instead of shipping a palette.

The style is sampled from a mermaid block inside the docs shadow root, NOT documentElement: the docs page never sets a font on html, so the root's computed fontFamily is the UA default (serif) while the block inherits .docs's var(--font-primary) and the rendered content's real size.

  • @param style Computed style of a .docs-mermaid block.
  • @returns JSON string for render_diagram's Theme::from_json.

renderMermaidBlocks

Renders every unprocessed .docs-mermaid block inside container into an inline SVG diagram. Safe to call repeatedly — processed nodes are marked (data-processed), so later payloads don't re-render earlier diagrams.

  • @param container The docs-content box holding rendered payload HTML.
